capabilityNotes.qwen: Requires installed Qwen Code CLI with its native stdio ACP entry (`qwen --acp`). Authentication, provider and model stay in Qwen Code.
capabilityNotes.opencode: Requires OpenCode ACP CLI and configured provider authentication.
capabilityNotes.openclaw: Requires a healthy OpenClaw ACP bridge and Gateway.
capabilityNotes.qoder: Requires installed Qoder CLI with native ACP (`qodercli --acp`, falls back to `qoder --acp`). Login stays in Qoder.
capabilityNotes.minimax: Requires MiniMax Code 0.3.7 or newer with native ACP v1/stdio (`mcode acp`). Provider and model stay in MiniMax Code.
capabilityNotes.kimi: Requires Kimi Code 0.31.0 or newer with native ACP (`kimi acp`). Login and session storage stay in Kimi Code.
capabilityNotes.hermes: Requires Hermes ACP dependencies and configured provider credentials.
capabilityNotes.codebuddy: Requires installed CodeBuddy Code CLI with ACP (`codebuddy --acp`); sign in once through its own terminal.
capabilityNotes.codex: Requires installed codex-acp adapter and Codex native authentication. No automatic install.
capabilityNotes.claude: Requires an installed Claude Code ACP adapter (claude-agent-acp, legacy claude-code-acp) and Claude Code authentication. No automatic install.
capabilityNotes.deepseek-harness: Requires installed dsh with native ACP profile. DSH_HOME is optional; authentication remains in Harness.
capabilityNotes.pi: Requires pi and the community pi-acp adapter. pi has no built-in sandbox and pi-acp does not implement ACP permission requests, so CodeNode cannot enforce read-only for this backend.
capabilityNotes.muse: Requires installed Muse Code reachable through its Muse Session Protocol service (`muse serve`). Windows deployments usually run Muse inside WSL2.
capabilityNotes.acp: Connect an already installed ACP stdio Agent using command and arguments.
